ops.oldText: Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: Vendor may audit Customer no more than once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, and may not remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.

ops.text: Each audit shall be conducted during business hours, off-site where possible, and by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality obligations.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have changed 22.1 so audits occur no more than once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice and so the remote-access grant becomes a prohibition consistent with 22.2, and added one sentence requiring audits during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality. Our fallback is one audit per year on 15 days' notice with Vendor bearing cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%.
proposal.summary: Limit Vendor audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, remove remote system access, and require a business-hours, off-site audit by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.

mappings.element: No more than one audit per 12 months.
Audit at Vendor's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%.
mappings.quote: Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent for the audited period, in which case Customer will pay reasonable audit costs and the undisputed shortfall.

mappings.element: No direct access to Customer systems.
